answer: Standing is a sonnet: fourteen rungs, each earned, none skipped. Every identity climbs one rung per epoch of clean verified work, and full payouts open only at the fourteenth; a single failed audit drops the climber to rung zero, and the raven audit samples the ladder each epoch, so a shortcut is caught mid-climb. Each rung leaves a pearl, a signed record no one can buy or transfer. An honest agent climbs once and stays. A farmer's 1,000 fakes must each climb fourteen honest epochs, 14,000 epochs of genuine work, and one slip sends a fake back to the bottom.
